info.title: CP Backend API
info.description: REST API for the property maintenance system

post.summary: Sign in with a login identifier and password
Sign out and revoke the current session

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name or login identifier; trimmed, blank means no search

get.summary: List accounts newest first with name/login search, role and active-status filters

post.summary: Create an account and optionally place a Resident

get.summary: Read an account, including inactive accounts

patch.summary: Update an account and optionally place or release a Resident

post.summary: Deactivate an account while preserving history; idempotent

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of unitNumber; trimmed, blank means no search

parameters.name: displayStatus
parameters.description: Computed unit status; maintenance takes precedence over active resident occupancy

get.summary: List property units (Admin), newest first (createdAt DESC, id DESC)
Read a unit, including archived units (Admin)

post.summary: Archive an empty unit with no active reports (Admin); idempotent

put.summary: Place or atomically move an active resident (Admin); occupied destinations conflict

delete.summary: Release the resident without deactivating the account (Admin); idempotent

get.summary: Read the configured property (all authenticated roles)

patch.summary: Update the property (Admin); logoUrl only accepts null to clear the logo

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match against report number or title; maximum 160 characters.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Matches final priority, or proposed priority when the report has not been reviewed.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive calendar date in Asia/Jakarta (YYYY-MM-DD), applied to reportedAt.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Inclusive calendar date in Asia/Jakarta (YYYY-MM-DD), applied to reportedAt.

get.summary: List reports visible to the authenticated actor

post.summary: Create a damage report as an Admin or Resident
Verify a Resident report and set its final priority (Admin)
Reject a Resident report with a reason (Admin)
Assign an active Technician to a verified report (Admin)
Start assigned work with an estimated arrival time (Technician)

put.summary: Save or replace assigned work result

post.summary: Approve and close completed maintenance work (Admin)

put.summary: Upload or replace a report receipt
Upload or replace the property logo (Admin)

get.summary: List closed maintenance history for an accessible unit
